user.title: Add a board
user.description: Watch the departures from one stop, or plan a journey between two places.

menu_options.search: Search for a stop by name
menu_options.journey: Plan a journey between two places

search.title: Find the departure stop
search.description: Enter part of the stop name, for example "Viru".

gtfs_id.title: Enter the departure stop ID
gtfs_id.description: The GTFS ID as used by peatus.ee, for example estonia:1292.

pick_stop.title: Select the departure stop
pick_stop.description: Stop names repeat across Estonia, so the platforms of one stop are listed together: by place with Tallinn first, then by transport mode. The municipality, direction, zone and served lines are shown to help you pick the right platform.

destination.title: Destination (optional)
destination.description: Leave empty to show all departures from {stop}. Enter a stop name to only show departures that continue to that stop.

settings.title: Departure board settings
settings.description: Only the selected transport modes are shown. Tallinn's trolleybus routes are published as buses by the data source, so they are listed separately here. Leave the lines empty to show every route calling at {stop}, or pick the ones you travel with — filtering to a rarely served line makes each update fetch more departures to find enough of them. Polling more often than once a minute is not useful, as the timetable data does not change faster than that.

journey.title: Choose where the journey runs
journey.description: Pick a zone, person or device tracker at each end. Both ends are places rather than stops, so the plan includes the walk to the first stop and from the last one. Prefer a person over a raw device tracker: a person follows whichever tracker is actually reporting a position, while a tracker that only knows which network you are on publishes no coordinates and cannot be planned from.

journey_settings.title: Journey settings
journey_settings.description: Only journeys using the selected transport modes are offered. Tallinn's trolleybus routes are published as buses by the data source, so they are listed separately here. Leave the lines empty to be offered any route, or enter the line numbers you are willing to travel with — a journey is only offered when every ride on it uses one of them. Walking and cycling speeds are a maximum along the street rather than an average, so set them a little below your real pace. Planning a journey costs the data source far more than reading a timetable, so poll it sparingly.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach peatus.ee. Please try again.
error.unknown_stop: No stop exists with that GTFS ID.
error.same_stop: The destination must be different from the departure stop.
error.same_place: The destination must be different from the starting place.

abort.already_configured: This stop and destination combination is already set up.
abort.already_configured_journey: A journey between these two places is already set up.
